meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 每次回答前会先检索之前存下的相关回忆，回答后再把新要点存进记忆。记忆存放在独立的挂载目录里，容器重启也不会丢失。
howto.when: 当 agent 运行在默认 Claude provider 上，每次对话回合前后触发：回答前调取相关记忆，回答后存储新见解。容器启动时会自动注册钩子。

say.text: 我们上次讨论的结论是什么？
say.note: Claude 会先检索之前存下的相关对话再回答。

say.text: 记住：项目截止日期是下周五。
say.note: 这轮结束后 Claude 会把这条写进持久记忆。

say.text: 我之前说过我喜欢什么样的配色方案？
say.note: Claude 会从记忆里翻出你之前的偏好。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude retrieves relevant past memories before responding to each turn, then stores new insights after the turn. Memory lives in a dedicated mounted directory and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of each conversation turn when the agent runs on the default Claude provider: before responding, relevant memory is surfaced; after the turn, new insights are stored. Hooks are registered on container startup.

say_en.text: What was our conclusion from the last discussion?
say_en.note: Claude will search stored memories before replying.

say_en.text: Remember: the project deadline is next Friday.
say_en.note: This will be written into persistent memory after the turn.

say_en.text: What color scheme did I say I prefer earlier?
say_en.note: Claude will pull your earlier preference from memory.
